text:
Send instant push notifications to your phone or desktop using simple HTTP requests 😲

This free, open-source notification service makes it effortless to trigger push alerts directly from your scripts, servers, cron jobs, or AI agents with just a quick HTTP call.

Ideal for:
- Long-running scripts & background tasks
- AI agent completions
- CI/CD build pipelines
- Server health monitoring
- Automated deployments & backups
- Custom workflows and much more

If you build or automate anything, this tool is definitely worth keeping in your stack :)

GitHub repo 🔗: github(DOT)com/binwiederhier/ntfy
